=='''Overview'''==
'''Agony''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. He is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]].

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1="This world shall know real agony..."
|caption2="There's no such thing as true peace! As long as we live in this cursed world, PEACE IS IMPOSSIBLE!"
}}{{Main Stats}}

== Passive Ability: ALMIGHTY PUSH! ==
Every time Agony attacks, he uses the Almighty Push's overwhelming force to push back enemies by a few studs. Agony is a good support legendary though it is not recommended to get him as your first legendary as there are more useful ones. 

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
